newsitem.title: USA: Culligan adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Culligan adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Monday its board of directors adopted a stockholder rights plan, but the plan is not in response to an effort to acquire the company.
One preferred stock purchase right per common share will be distributed as a dividend to each shareholder of record at the close of business on September 26, the company said.
The right can be exercised if a person or group owns 15 percent or more of the company's common stock. Culligan said it is not aware of any such effort to acquire the company.

In addition, the company said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of about 4.99 million shares of its common stock on behalf of certain stockholders.
The shareholders include Steven J. Green and an affiliated entity, and entities affiliated with Carl C. Icahn, the company said.
The company will not receive any proceeds unless underwriters' over-allotment options to purchase up to 749,239 shares are exercised.
Completion of the proposed offering is expected to significantly increase the public float of the company, Culligan said. Green and Icahn control 24.8 percent of the company's stock.
